Samir Patel: Vendor flagged 12 H100s on RMA hold in FRA warehouse. Forwarder says missing PO ref, customs won't release.
Lia Nguyen: Which vendor? and which FRA depot? pls paste AWB.
Marco (Vendor Ops): It's Storova / FRA-DCK7. AWB 1Z999AA123456789. Photos attached in their ticket. They need a new commercial invoice with HS code 8471.80 and our PO number to match the forwarder manifest.
Samir Patel: Copy. Are these replacement units from our committed pool or vendor loaners?
Marco (Vendor Ops): Committed pool — contract indicates vendor covers customs for replacement shipments, but forwarder is refusing release without PO on doc. They want a billing contact to sign off for customs broker.
Jess - Logistics: If we re-issue docs we need: (1) PO ref, (2) updated commercial invoice, (3) RMA batch manifest with serials. I can generate the invoice but need confirmation on cost allocation (vendor vs Redwood).

Samir Patel: Not without Legal sign-off. Don't accept waivers that shift duty/responsibility to us. Leave it as negotiation but escalate.
ops-bot: [automated] Created ticket INF-4892 and attached AWB + depot photos.

Marco (Vendor Ops): Vendor replied: can reissue invoice today if we provide PO and billing email. They insist on broker indemnity or we sign broker on our end.
Lia Nguyen: Provide PO but cc billing@storova.com and request vendor sign indemnity. Also @legal-team please review indemnity template ASAP.
Samir Patel: I'll draft a one-line indemnity addendum for procurement to present. Jess, hold on reroute for 2h while we try docs.
Jess - Logistics: Roger. If I don't hear back by 16:00 CET I'll start reroute and allocate cost to temporary ops buffer.
Marco (Vendor Ops): Action items: vendor to send reissued invoice (ETA ~90m), Marco to escalate broker indemnity, Samir to draft addendum, Jess standby for reroute.
Samir Patel: Thanks — keep updates here.
